title: Terminal Aesthetic by @alxshp: Modern Postgres Terminal 2.0 🐘 Built in Rust. Available on Linux + mac
notes:
Modern Postgres Terminal 2.0 🐘 Built in Rust. Available on Linux + macOS. http://pgterm.dev No dashboards. No 15-tab workflow. Built for developers. Built for AI agents. > connect > explore > query > inspect > debug > optimize > understand what is actually happening > fix the problem > ship No jumping between tools just to understand your database. One terminal for Postgres. Built for the way we work now.

Designer: @alxshp. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
